hazards.evidence: White hair dryer lying on the vanity right next to the sink, with its cord plugged into the wall outlet beside the basin.
White toilet seat and bowl against a white tank and light tile floor, giving very low contrast that is easy to misperceive.
Solid black bath mat on the light tile floor in the walking path, which can be misread as a hole and is also a trip edge.
